inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text: Local organizers are taking to the petition tables in southern Alberta collecting signatures supposedly to protect the watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal started by Corb Lund last month is pushing a citizen initiative petition calling on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration”. This has all the signs of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions. They are allowing the signatures and the public effort to build the illusion of real opposition while their concealed interests in the coal keep moving forward anyway. It's the usual narrative inversion where the surface story distracts from who is really pulling the strings and what they stand to gain.
